source_visual_observations: CircleO with radiiOA,OB,OC, chordAB and chordBC; OC perpendicularAB; ABC25°.
audit.independent_solution: Inscribed angleABC=25° gives arcAC=50°. Since OC is perpendicular to chordAB, it bisects minor arcAB, giving arcCB=50° too. Therefore central AOB=100°, choice C.
